goals: Verify the execution logic of LoadDataTasklet with both populated and empty query results

Verify the end-to-end integration and successful execution of the loadDataJob
Verify that the JobRunner correctly launches the batch job
activities: Define SQL query and create mock data list
Mock JdbcTemplate to return the mock data for the SQL query
Execute LoadDataTasklet with mock step contribution and chunk context

Mock JdbcTemplate to return an empty list for any query
Execute LoadDataTasklet with mock step contribution and chunk context
Assert that the tasklet execution status is FINISHED
Assert that the injected loadDataJob and loadDataStep beans are not null
